podcast.title: Regional Emo Variation
podcast.body: Midwest Emo is given as an instance of the regional specializations that emerged from the broader emo phenomenon, reflecting diverse local interpretations of the genre. "If you wanted to get really deep, there were all the regional variations from North Carolina emo to Midwest emo to Aussie emo."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
